## portcheck completion powershell

Generate the autocompletion script for powershell

### Synopsis

Generate the autocompletion script for powershell.

To load completions in your current shell session:

	portcheck completion powershell | Out-String | Invoke-Expression

To load completions for every new session, add the output of the above command
to your powershell profile.


```
portcheck completion powershell [flags]
```

### Options

```
  -h, --help              help for powershell
      --no-descriptions   disable completion descriptions
```

### Options inherited from parent commands

```
      --json                shorthand for --output json
      --log-format string   log format: text or json (default "text")
      --no-color            disable colors (also honors NO_COLOR)
  -o, --output string       output format: table, plain, csv, json (default: table on a terminal, plain otherwise)
  -v, --verbose             log diagnostic details to stderr
```
